# Vasylian: websites for small businesses (Artur Vasilyan)

> Artur Vasilyan (also spelled Vasylian) is a web designer and developer in Kyiv, Ukraine, who makes websites for small
> businesses in Latvia, Lithuania, Estonia and Poland, mostly construction companies, car services and installers.
> A free first version of the homepage is ready within 24 hours; the whole site (up to 5 pages) costs from 300 € one-time
> (Poland: from 1 990 zł), with no monthly fee. Contact: arthur@vasylian.com, WhatsApp +380 68 980 42 55.
